description: For a project profile (use, city, stage and optional details): how many norms apply, which depend on missing data or need a specialist, the next permit actions with their legal source, and which questions would narrow the list most. Every omitted detail keeps norms in (over-inclusive by design).

beds.description: Number of beds, e.g. in a hotel, hospital or care home; used for thresholds in norms

building_height.description: Building height, m; used for height thresholds in norms

city.description: Municipality slug, e.g. tel-aviv, jerusalem. See list_profile_options.

features.description: Comma-separated project element codes from list_profile_options (features), e.g. pool; 'none' = checked and none apply; omit = not checked

floor_area.description: Floor area, m²; used for area thresholds in norms

height_class.description: Building height class: low, high or multistory. Omit if unknown (no norm is excluded)

occupancy.description: Number of occupants; used for occupancy thresholds in norms

role.description: Show the norms for one party, e.g. architect, developer, fire (fire safety consultant), authority: a role code from list_profile_options. Omit for all parties

rooms.description: Number of rooms; used for thresholds in norms

site.description: Comma-separated plot condition codes that apply; 'none' = checked and none apply; omit = not checked

stage.description: Project stage: feasibility (היתכנות ותכנון ראשוני), design (תכנון מפורט), permit (רישוי ובקשה להיתר), execution (ביצוע באתר), completion (גמר וטופס 4), operation (תפעול ותחזוקה). Omit = all stages

status.description: new = new building; existing = existing building

storeys.description: Number of storeys; used for thresholds in norms

track.description: Permit track: standard, short or fast. Omit if unknown (no norm is excluded)

use.description: Use code, or several comma-separated for a mixed building, e.g. residential or retail,office. See list_profile_options.

name: project_overview
title: Project overview (what applies)
